description: Error Handling & Robustness improvements: Checkpointing/resume, per-clip timeout, prompt quality validation, progress tracking with ETA, and CLIP fp4/fp8 fallback.
steps: 1. Checkpointing/resume: Add a Checkpoint class that saves/loads checkpoint.json after each successful beat. Fields: completed_beats (list of int), clip_paths (dict mapping beat_idx to path), bible_state (serialized CharacterBible), scene_history (list), current_seed (int), config_hash (hash of relevant config for invalidation). In InfiniteFlowEngine, add checkpoint_dir param (default: output_dir). At start of run(), check for existing checkpoint and resume from last completed beat. After each successful beat in _generate_single_segment(), save checkpoint.

2. Per-clip timeout: Add a clip_timeout_sec: int = 600 param (default 10 min) to generate_clip() and InfiniteFlowEngine. Wrap the generate_clip() call in _generate_single_segment() with a threading-based timeout (using concurrent.futures.ThreadPoolExecutor with timeout). On timeout, raise a ClipTimeoutError (custom exception). Handle it in the retry logic by reducing frames and retrying.

3. Prompt quality validation: Add a _validate_prompt(prompt: str, raw_beat: str) -> tuple[bool, str] function that checks: (a) minimum word count >= 30, (b) no excessive repetition (no word repeated > 5 times in sequence), (c) prompt is substantially different from raw beat (at least 2x longer). If validation fails, return (False, reason). In _process_beat(), after EasyPromptEngine.generate(), validate the result. If it fails, log warning and fall back to using the raw beat directly (with _build_neg applied).

4. Progress tracking: Add a ProgressTracker class that writes a progress.json file with: total_beats, completed_beats, current_beat, elapsed_seconds, avg_seconds_per_beat, estimated_remaining_seconds, estimated_completion_time (ISO format), status ('running'/'complete'/'error'). Instantiate in InfiniteFlowEngine.run() and update after each beat. Write to output_dir/progress.json.

5. CLIP fp4/fp8 fallback: The reference file LTX2_InfiniteFlow_12Scene.py already has a try/except pattern for this. Verify that the current LTX.PY's _load_clip_encode() (from FEAT-001) has the fallback. It should try loading _M_CLIP1 (fp4) first, catch any exception, then try the fp8 variant 'gemma_3_12B_it_fp8_scaled.safetensors'. If FEAT-001 already includes this pattern from the existing code, just ensure it is properly integrated into the new _load_clip_encode() sub-function.
acceptance_criteria: Checkpoint class exists with save() and load() methods
generate_clip() and InfiniteFlowEngine have clip_timeout_sec param
_validate_prompt() function exists with word count and repetition checks
ProgressTracker class exists with update() and to_json() methods
verification: python -c "import ast; tree=ast.parse(open('/projects/sandbox/ltx2/LTX.PY').read()); names=[n.name for n in ast.walk(tree) if isinstance(n, (ast.ClassDef, ast.FunctionDef))]; assert 'Checkpoint' in names; assert 'ClipTimeoutError' in names or 'ProgressTracker' in names; assert '_validate_prompt' in names; assert 'ProgressTracker' in names; print('Error handling features present')"
findings: All 5 sub-features implemented successfully. Added concurrent.futures and hashlib imports to Cell 3. Checkpoint class saves after each beat in _run_scene_chain. ProgressTracker writes progress.json. ClipTimeoutError with ThreadPoolExecutor timeout wraps generate_clip in _generate_single_segment. _validate_prompt checks word count, repetition, and expansion ratio. CLIP fp4/fp8 fallback with try/except in _load_clip_encode. All backward compatible with default params.
